revisions.concept: One focal Roman communal latrine seen from the front at eye level: a long carved stone bench with keyhole openings, clear water flowing in an open stone channel beneath it. Simple background: plain warm plaster wall. One single scene, clear silhouette, safe margins; no clutter, no lettering.
revisions.reason: Run 38014013365 rejected thumbnail-C (adultAnatomy, historicalAccuracy, correctProp): a 'technical isometric' latrine cutaway produced a modern flexible hose, a metal valve and multi-panel cells with detached floating legs. The repair keeps the approved latrine subject, title and overlay as one uninhabited period scene.
